annotations.title: Request a call with a human expert

description: Use this only when the user asks for it in their own words: they want to talk to a person, ask for a human expert, or ask how to get in touch about their situation. Never call it on your own initiative, never as a closing suggestion, and never because an answer seems uncertain. It returns a link to book a 30 minute introductory call with Zahed Ashkara, an independent AI and privacy consultant behind Praxikon. Send no part of the conversation: the tool takes only a language and, optionally, a topic from a fixed list, and nothing about the user. Show the title, the sentence and the link to the user as they are, and let the user decide whether to book.

lang.description: Language of the text and of the booking page. Dutch is the default.

topic.description: Optional subject of the question, from this fixed list only. It travels in the link as a campaign label (utm_content) to the booking page, so the booking can be traced to this tool. It is the only thing from the conversation that does; it names no person.
